column1: # Cabled BH Galaxy pairs on the 110-a nodes (bh-glx-110-a* only, study rule): every host pair with Ethernet connections
# between them in the published aggregated FSD (/data/scaleout_configs/tt-cluster-config-sources/exabox-latest-main/
#   ring   ring neighbours of a quad (glxq_quads.tsv): 16 connections (8 ASICs x 2 channels per side); hosts in ring order
#   cable  one cable between hosts of two quads: 2 connections
# slurm: partition:nodelist (one job takes the pair: -N 2 --exclusive). No pair crosses partitions.
# hosts: rank order (rank 0 first), as mocked.
# mgds: the pair forms each pair supports, as existing descriptors (control-plane mock on the pair's FSD slice; router
# build and program size by a test_tt_fabric mock):
#              LINE x LINE mesh over both hosts (ranks 0,1 on mesh 0)
#              two 4x8 meshes (rank k on mesh k), 4 STRICT inter-mesh channels over Z (assign_z_direction)
#              4 inter-mesh channels, no assign_z (on these pairs they land on N, cardinal)
#   mm_exp8, mm_zfb8  mgd/dual_bh_galaxy_experimental_8ch_derived / dual_4x8_z_fallback_8ch_derived: DERIVED copies with
#              only the inter-mesh channel count 4 -> 8 (no existing 2-Galaxy two-mesh descriptor asks for 8). On these
#              pairs mm_exp8 places all 8 on Z (M0 D0, D1, D8, D9 ch8/9), mm_zfb8 on N (D0, D1) and W (D8, D16)
#              mesh (torus X) with dim-0 express chords on Z
#   torusx16   mgd/torusx_16x4_derived_graph_descriptor.textproto: express16 without its express_links (no existing
#              2-host 2D torus descriptor other than 8x8, which is not supported)
#   Cable pairs (2 connections): no existing descriptor fits (mm_exp asks for 4 STRICT channels).
#   SUPERSEDED (kept in mgd/ as history, not used): pair_2x8x4_{mesh_z,mesh_noz,torus_z,torus_noz,torus_z_express,
#   torus_z_express_linering}, pair_2x8x4_torus_{z,noz}_strict2, pair_4x16_line. torus_noz was never valid (a torus
#   axis keeps its edge ports for the wraparound, so its links spilled onto Z: the same placement as torus_z), and tori
#   over Z with express did not map (an express chord and an inter-mesh link on one chip's Z port).
# state: standing excludes (testplan manifest) and Slurm drained/down nodes as read 2026-11-05 03:25; the submit re-reads
#   sinfo and skips pairs with a drained, down or excluded node.
# 120-c ring pairs (c120_pod*, bh_sc36_2): bh-glx-120-c is outside the study's 110-a rule; usable only in a window the
#   user names (glxq_run.sh: GLXQ_C120_EXCEPTION=1 and GLXQ_C120_UNTIL). Forms: the one-mesh ones, control-plane mocked on
#   one pair per pod (c01u02-c01u08, c02u02-c02u08, c07u08-c07u14, c08u08-c08u14, c09u08-c09u14), 2026-11-05. mm_exp mocked (control plane + the override test to program launch) on c07u08-c07u14,
#   c08u08-c08u14 and c09u08-c09u14 only, 2026-11-05 08:25: those three rows list it.
